create.name: Bea Walker
create.bio:
Bea Walker is a Los Angeles yoga and meditation teacher and holistic coach who works mainly with women living with anxiety. She has spoken openly about her own long experience of anxiety, and says that breathwork, meditation, yoga, Ayurveda and body-based practices were what slowly helped her feel steady again. She went on to train as a holistic health and mindset coach, a registered yoga teacher, a sound healer and a meditation teacher certified through Chopra, and she makes clear on her site that she is not a therapist.

Her sessions are online. In one-to-one coaching she combines conversation with breathing, somatic and nervous-system practices that clients can use day to day, and she also offers private meditation lessons for beginners and for people wanting to deepen a practice, as well as energy sessions centred on the chakras. She has written The Anxiety Journal, a downloadable workbook of reflection prompts, affirmations and calming practices, and she records short guided meditations for sleep, gratitude and relaxation on her YouTube channel and on Insight Timer. Her blog, Holistic Bea, mixes seasonal recipes and rituals with pieces on yoga, meditation and stress, and she runs wellness sessions for workplaces.

courses.title: The Anxiety Reset: Individual Coaching
courses.description: Hour-long one-to-one video sessions that pair coaching with breathing, somatic and nervous-system practices. The aim is to ease stress and anxious thinking in the moment and to leave clients with simple tools for daily life.

courses.title: 1:1 Guided Meditation Sessions
courses.description: Private online meditation lessons with a Chopra-certified teacher, for complete beginners or for people who want to deepen an existing practice. Sessions focus on finding a way of meditating that is easy to keep up.

courses.title: The Anxiety Journal
courses.description: A downloadable, fillable workbook of more than 100 pages. It explains how the nervous system responds to stress and gathers regulation practices, an emotions wheel, reflection questions, journal pages and daily affirmations.
